title: JavaScript (Vanilla)
tagline: Closures, prototypes, the Event Loop, Promises, DOM engineering, and modern ES2024 internals.
description: Build deep mastery of vanilla JavaScript: lexical scoping, closures, this binding, prototypal inheritance, microtasks vs macrotasks, async/await concurrency, ES modules, DOM delegation, memory profiling, and interview output tracing.
whatYoullLearn: Trace hoisting, Temporal Dead Zone, lexical closures, and garbage collection
Predict this binding across method calls, arrow functions, call/apply/bind, and new
Master Promises, async/await, AbortController, and Event Loop microtask ordering
Use modern ES2023+ immutable array methods (toSorted, toSpliced, Map, Set, WeakMap)
Architect fast DOM interactions with Event Delegation, IntersectionObserver, and Fetch
Implement Metaprogramming with Proxy, Reflect, Symbols, Generators, and Iterators

levelSummaries.Beginner: Variables, types, coercion, control flow, functions, arrays, objects, and destructuring.
levelSummaries.Intermediate: Closures, this binding, prototypes, classes, DOM events, Fetch API, and error handling.
levelSummaries.Advanced: Event Loop microtasks, Promise combinators, ES modules, Proxy/Symbols, generators, and memory tuning.
